title: Full-Length Machining Process of a Falcon on the DMU 85 H-monoBLOCK
description:
In this captivating video, we walk you through the entire machining process on the DMU 85 H-monoBLOCK, from raw material loading to the impressive final result. Witness the mesmerizing process of creating a falcon demo part utilizing the cutting-edge capabilities of the DMU 85 H-monoBLOCK in a full-length story. This is precision machining at its finest!
 
Highlights:
• 200 programing hours: Every contour and detail has been considered for a flawless result
• 70 machine hours: Watch the versatile DMU 85 H-monoBLOCK handle complex geometries with utmost precision
• 63 tool changes showcasing the extreme versatility of our 5-axis CNC machine
• Close-up shots of the sculpting of the machining part from AW-7075 (AlZnMgCu 1,5)
 
Here are the key steps:
